title: [security] A datasource write path admits callers below the capability the datasource admin door requires for create/update — detail withheld pending maintainer
body:
Filing gate: **① a reproducible defect with a named landing site** — the save admission for datasource metadata, next to the read admission PR #21119 adds (`packages/rest`, `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta.ts`). `reach:` the public REST API, measured once by the #21087 dev on a booted showcase; the dispatched dev re-measures first. Reader: the maintainer, who holds the request; dispatched directly at the maintainer's request. Dedupe: the write-side twin of #21087 (read side, PR #21119) and of the #9593 admin-door gate (closed); no open card covers the write side.

QA-source: #21056 · integration-system.datasource-credential-refusal-matrix · acceptance[7]

## What is known publicly

- The datasource admin door requires `manage_platform_settings` to create or update a datasource (`packages/services/service-datasource/src/admin-routes.ts`).
- A second write path for datasource definitions admits a caller who holds an authoring capability but not `manage_platform_settings`. The status was measured once. Whether a definition saved that way reaches a live connection pool is not measured yet.
- Read side: #21087 / PR #21119 holds every datasource metadata read to the admin door's capability. This card is the write-side parity.

**Detail withheld pending maintainer** (RUNNER rule 2). Ruling, verbatim (Claude Code session `session_01MRdbfpy4sQT8bUjmMhxsN7`, 2026-10-01): 「立脱敏卡并派发（推荐）」.

## Acceptance

- Datasource definitions are written through every write path only by holders of the admin door's capability.
- The refusal is pinned on both sides: an author is refused with nothing persisted, and the holder is admitted.
- What a previously admitted write could reach is measured and recorded.
